inputs_used: public AppWorld API Docs and Supervisor API source

termination_and_completion.interpretation: Eight references to completion in the prompt did not ensure the environment completion call. Nine confident finals bypassed it; the one actual invocation occurred in an episode that later timed out and was not successful.

actions.api_doc_counting_predicate: One count per action whose public code text contains api_docs; a broad textual measure that can include compound or non-executing references.
actions.interpretation: Most episodes exhausted the usable 80-second decision/action period after six or seven turns. API documentation discovery consumed a large share of turns; the small action budget was not the binding limit.

representative_public_findings: Several completed=true trajectories contained plausible final answers or effects but no complete_task call, so private evaluation correctly remained unsuccessful.
The public complete_task schema requires a concise direct answer if and only if the instruction requests one; action-only tasks must omit it.
Public traces include avoidable detailed-doc lookups, repeated show calls, unauthenticated calls, incorrect requester usage, and assumptions about response fields.
The prompt requires detailed docs before calls and gives no remaining-time signal, while each model turn uses thinking and resends task/application descriptions.
decision: Prioritize general completion-evidence enforcement and turn efficiency before considering planners or voting. Test concise API Docs search, selective detailed docs, direct-answer completion, remaining-time feedback, and sampling/latency variants on a prespecified small public train screen. Promote only candidates with actual task successes to repeated dev confirmation.
